findings.requirement: REQ-115 (Files: «each grant on a table is applied only when that table exists»)
findings.problem: A grant whose table name is misspelt, or names a table no migration creates, is skipped silently on every database, so a missing grant shows only later as a permission error of a route.
findings.needed: Optional for the code design: a case of MG-6 (or a unit test) that every table named in grants.sql is created by some migration file, so a skipped grant can only be one of a newer migration.
